visual_events.label: Mason picks up a brick and sets it on edge onto mortar at the wall corner
visual_events.description: From 0.0s to 1.2s, the primary mason (ent_mason) reaches to the left wing of the low L-shaped brick wall (ent_wall), picks up a loose red brick, and lifts it over a bed of grey mortar on the third course near the corner junction. From 1.2s to 4.3s, he places the brick on edge onto the mortar bed, creating an open rectangular cavity alongside the adjacent brick on the right wing, and presses and adjusts its alignment with both hands. From 4.3s to 5.2s, he releases the brick and straightens up.

visual_events.description: From 5.2s to 7.5s, the mason (ent_mason) walks behind the wall toward screen left and exits the frame at 7.5s. From 7.5s to 11.4s, the frame shows only the static brick corner (ent_wall), background brick stacks, and green cylindrical tanks (ent_green_tanks) with no people visible. At 11.4s, the mason re-enters from the foreground left carrying a long metallic bar/straightedge and a plumb bob (ent_plumb_bob), walks across to the right side of the wall, sets the long bar down on the ground at the right around 14.0s–14.8s, and steps behind the right wing of the wall holding the plumb bob.

visual_events.label: Mason checks vertical alignment of the corner brickwork with a plumb bob and adjusts the newly laid brick
visual_events.description: From 15.2s to 20.3s, the mason (ent_mason) holds the plumb bob string and wooden block against the outer right face of the corner brickwork (ent_wall) to check verticality, then nudges the top brick slightly while a second worker (ent_coworker) walks into the background from right to left and bends down near the left wing. From 20.3s to 22.8s, the mason moves the plumb bob to the inner face of the newly laid brick on edge (laid in ve_01_place_corner_brick), suspending the bob down alongside the lower courses. From 22.8s to 25.5s, he uses both hands to slightly shift and rock the brick on edge into vertical alignment. From 25.5s to 27.6s, he re-applies the plumb bob spacer block against the top edge of that brick to re-check plumb. From 27.6s through the end of the clip at 31.68s, he holds and presses the brick steady with both hands while looking down at the plumb line, as the second worker walks back and forth in the background.
